title: Randomized teleport
description: The Random Teleportation Datapack (RTP) allows you to teleport randomly from 0 coordinates 2500 blocks in each direction.
body:
The Random Teleportation Datapack (RTP) allows you to teleport randomly from 0 coordinates 2500 blocks in each direction. This value can be changed with the command /trigger rtp_setting_X+, X-, Z+, Z-, where X+ and Z+ are the maximum values ​​(preferably with +), and X- and Z- are the minimum values ​​(preferably with -).

To teleport, enter /trigger rtp and you'll be teleported!
